AppConfig

class AppConfig[source]

Bases: object

Hold application configuration constants and helper methods.

Attributes:
ICON_APPstr, class attribute

Qt resource path of the application icon.

LOGO_APPstr, class attribute

Qt resource path of the application logo.

PLATAFORM_SUFFIXstr, class attribute

Suffix identifier of the platform ("TEA").

PLATAFORM_MANUALstr, class attribute

Identifier of the platform manual ("Manual").

VERSIONstr, class attribute

Application version shown in the status bar.

DEFAULT_DATE_FORMATstr, class attribute

Date mask used when the language is not en_US ("%d/%m/%Y").

DEFAULT_HOUR_FORMATstr, class attribute

Hour mask used when the language is not en_US ("%H:%M:%S").

DEFAULT_HOUR_MINUTE_FORMATstr, class attribute

Hour-minute mask used when the language is not en_US ("%H:%M").

SETTINGS_GERALstr, class attribute

Section of the general settings in the configuration file ("geral").

SETTINGS_GERAL_DATE_MASKstr, class attribute

Settings key of the date mask.

SETTINGS_GERAL_HOUR_MASKstr, class attribute

Settings key of the hour mask.

SETTINGS_GERAL_HOUR_MINUTE_MASKstr, class attribute

Settings key of the hour-minute mask.

SETTINGS_GERAL_LANGUAGEstr, class attribute

Settings key of the language.

SETTINGS_GERAL_VERSIONstr, class attribute

Settings key of the application version.

USA_DATE_FORMATstr, class attribute

Date mask used for en_US ("%m/%d/%Y").

USA_HOUR_FORMATstr, class attribute

Hour mask used for en_US ("%I:%M:%S %p").

USA_HOUR_MINUTE_FORMATstr, class attribute

Hour-minute mask used for en_US ("%I:%M %p").

TRANSLATION_EXTENSIONstr, class attribute

Extension of the compiled Qt translation files (".qm").

static get_title()[source]

Return the translated application title.

Returns:
str

The title, from the pt_BR source text “Plataforma T-TEA”.

Notes

Translated at runtime with QCoreApplication.translate in the "TTeaApp" context, so it follows the installed translator.

static get_geral_date_mask()[source]

Return the date mask from the settings or by language.

Returns:
str

strftime mask for date display.

Notes

The value saved under geral/date_mask in the configuration file (PathConfig.config()) wins when it is not empty; it is set by LanguageService.apply_language. Otherwise the mask is USA_DATE_FORMAT ("%m/%d/%Y") when the current language is en_US and DEFAULT_DATE_FORMAT ("%d/%m/%Y") otherwise.

static get_geral_hour_mask()[source]

Return the hour mask from the settings or by language.

Returns:
str

strftime mask for hour display.

Notes

The value saved under geral/hour_mask in the configuration file (PathConfig.config()) wins when it is not empty. Otherwise the mask is USA_HOUR_FORMAT ("%I:%M:%S %p") when the current language is en_US and DEFAULT_HOUR_FORMAT ("%H:%M:%S") otherwise.

static get_geral_hour_minute_mask()[source]

Return the hour-minute mask from the settings or by language.

Returns:
str

strftime mask for hour-minute display.

Notes

The value saved under geral/hour_minute_mask in the configuration file (PathConfig.config()) wins when it is not empty; it is set by LanguageService.apply_language. Otherwise the mask is USA_HOUR_MINUTE_FORMAT ("%I:%M %p") when the current language is en_US and DEFAULT_HOUR_MINUTE_FORMAT ("%H:%M") otherwise.

static config_file_exists(filename='config.ini')[source]

Check whether the configuration file exists.

Parameters:
filenamestr, optional

Name of the configuration file. Default is PathConfig.CONFIG_FILENAME.

Returns:
bool

True if the file exists, False otherwise.

Notes

Delegates to PathConfig.config_file_exists, which also creates the user directories if needed.
